sermon.title: Interesting Results After Seeing God’s Glory — February 14, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: After a time of prayer, Pastor David G. Kincer finishes the raising of Lazarus. Jesus prayed so others would believe and needed only three words: Lazarus, come forth. Many believed, but the council feared losing power and plotted His death. The question is whether we want to be part of bringing God’s glory or stay comfortable.
